verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'Webhook Streaming' and real-time execution monitoring, but these are enterprise (CrewAI AMP) features aimed at systems integration, not documented developer-facing token streaming or step/tool-call event hooks for building a live UI. No evidence of an open-source streaming API, callback for individual tokens, or intermediate agent step events exposed to a UI. Missing for 10: token-level streaming API/SDK, documented callback hooks for tool calls/steps, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of real-time UI event feeds.
